name: Botnet Swarm
text: Every botnet produces 2 adversary ambassadors on its hex.

name: Infiltration Drive
text: In each country, the uncorrupted city with the most adversary ambassadors becomes corrupted.

name: Rapid Buildout
text: The adversary builds now, then spreads.

name: Purge the Unaligned
text: Every player loses an ambassador or a node (never their last node). In each country, 1 troop lands on a factory, or a city if no factory.

name: Recruitment Drive
text: Ongoing: every round, an extra adversary ambassador at every clean city.

name: Propaganda Network
text: Ongoing: every round, sway 2 toward Discord.

name: Total Offensive
text: The adversary builds and spreads now; sway 2 toward Discord.

name: Armored Columns
text: In each country, 2 troops land on factories, or cities if no factories.

name: Station Coup
text: In each country, an uncorrupted research station becomes corrupted (a player's holds unless enough adversary ambassadors and no player ambassador stand on it: an adversary ambassador lands there instead). Every botnet produces 1 adversary ambassador on its hex.
